origin.description: Escape controls, and non-ASCII when the display is not UTF-8.
origin.usage: utf8_encode(x, width = 0, quote = FALSE, justify = "left", escapes = NULL, display = FALSE, utf8 = NULL)

arguments.name: width
arguments.text: Minimum field width. 0 pads to the longest element.

arguments.name: quote
arguments.text: Surround the text with quotes and escape internal quotes.

arguments.name: escapes
arguments.text: ANSI SGR parameter wrapped around each escape.

arguments.name: utf8
arguments.text: When false, non-ASCII characters become \\u and \\U escapes.

origin.details: Named controls use \\a through \\r. Other controls use \\u00XX. A style wraps \\n fully and only the first backslash of \\\\.

translation.description: The same C escapes. bytes are escaped one byte at a time.
translation.usage: utf8_encode(x, width=0, quote=False, justify="left", escapes=None, display=False, utf8=None)

arguments.name: width
arguments.text: Minimum field width. 0 pads to the longest element.

arguments.name: quote
arguments.text: Surround the text with quotes and escape internal quotes.

arguments.name: escapes
arguments.text: ANSI SGR parameter wrapped around each escape.

arguments.name: utf8
arguments.text: When false, non-ASCII characters become \\u and \\U escapes.

translation.details: escapes is an SGR string such as "1". The close sequence is ESC[0m.
